name: index state management routes
description: The stock Index Management plugin's policy, add, remove, explain, change_policy and retry routes, and the rollup, transform and snapshot-management list routes: validation messages, templates and the managed index record. Generated values are placeholders.
setup: no setup; the scenario creates its own indices and policies
placeholders: `{label}` in a request is the value the step that captured it received; `<label>` in a response is where that value appeared. `<volatile>` is a time, a counter or a generated value that differs on every run.
